mentions.name: agent6
mentions.description: This coding agent includes built-in sandboxing that restricts the network and filesystem access of commands it runs, offers several features not found in other agents, and focuses on polished UX across its CLI, TUI, and web UI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a coding agent with built in sandboxing to restrict network access or filesystem access of commands run. It also has a few other interesting features I haven't seen in other agents and I'm currently focusing on polishing the UX across its cli, tui, and web ui.
